observed_structure: qmm_n_impl fixes a non-transposed BlockMMA configuration, pairs a dense activation BlockLoader with a QuantizedBlockLoader bound to packed weights, scales, biases, group size, and bit width, and stages them in separate threadgroup tiles.
The kernel derives output-tile addresses, adjusts the packed-weight and scale/bias bases, constructs both loaders and the BlockMMA object, and derives the number of admitted output rows.

Four partial-M and K-divisibility branches repeat the same full-K sequence: a threadgroup-memory barrier, one load through each loader, a second threadgroup-memory barrier, mma on the staged tiles, and advancement of both loaders.

Branches with a K remainder safely load the final activation and weight extents for one terminal mma, then the kernel executes another barrier and selects a safe or full result store according to the output-row extent.
variant_notes: The packed-weight, scale, bias, group-size, bit-width, and dequantizing loader behavior belongs to this QMM-N implementation and is not normalized into the common recurrence.
Partial-M and K-remainder branches select safe-versus-unsafe load calls and a safe-versus-full result store; helper names do not establish bounds, zero-fill, or memory safety.
This observation covers qmm_n_impl only and does not generalize to the QMV, QMM-T, NAX, packing, rounding, numerical, or dispatch paths collected by the same operator occurrence.
